Name: Speed Boots
Author: gggl634624654567
Description:
Wearing normal boots increases movement speed by 0.5, while wearing advanced boots increases movement speed by 1.
Wearing a lucky bows or ears increases luck level by 1.
Wearing special Hat / Clothing / Ring / Trinket have different buff effects.

Advanced boots include Space Boots, Genie Shoes, Crystal Shoes, Emily's Magic Boots, Cinderclown Shoes, Dragonscale Boots, Mermaid Boots.

configs:
[spoiler][quote]
Speed of Wearing Boots config:
[code] "EnableBootsSpeed": true
"BaseBootsSpeed": 0.5
"AdvancedBootsSpeed": 1.0
"AdvancedBootsMinPrice": 350 //the boots which sell price above 350 is Advanced Boots
[/code][/quote][quote]
Luck of Wearing Hat config:
[code] "EnableHatLuck": true
"LuckForAllHat": false //if true, all hat will increases luck level.
"HatLuck": 1.0
"LuckHatsTypes": ["Bow", "Ear"]
[/code][/quote][quote]
Wearing special Hat / Clothing / Ring / Trinket buff effects config:
[code] "EnableSpecialHatBuffs": true
"SpecialHats": [
    "Hunter's Cap/Attack/1",
    "Fishing Hat/FishingLevel/1",
    "Straw Hat/FarmingLevel/1",
    ......
  ]
"EnableSpecialShirtBuffs": false,
"SpecialShirts": [......]
"EnableSpecialPantsBuffs": false,
"SpecialPants": [......]
"EnableSpecialRingBuffs": false,
"SpecialRings": [......]
"EnableSpecialTrinketBuffs": false,
"SpecialTrinkets": [......]

"EnableWandBuffs": false,
"WandSpeed": 1.0
[/code]
[code]﻿"AllowConfigEffects": false (this feature need simultaneously install Easy Valley MOD 0.0.9+)
[/code][/quote][/spoiler]

中文说明：
[spoiler]
[b][size=4]鞋子加速[/size][/b]
穿了鞋子时会获得增加移动速度的buff效果，低级鞋子默认增加0.5移速，高级鞋子默认增加1点移速。（一般属性值大于或等于水晶鞋/太空鞋的为高级鞋子）
戴上不同帽子时会获得相应增加幸运/耕种/觅食/钓鱼/采矿/战斗等属性的buff效果。

其他可配置项：（默认未启用，可在通用模组配置菜单中开启）
穿了不同的上衣/裤子/戒指/饰品时，可获得对应的buff效果。
手持传送权杖时，可获得增加移动速度的buff效果。

（可以编辑MOD目录下的config.json文件来自定义各种衣服/帽子/饰品等对应的buff，配置时名字需用Wiki上的英文名）
（可选）如果同时安装了[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21181]Easy Valley[/url]模组，可以在配置菜单中开启“自定义穿戴效果”的配置项，会在EasyValley模组的主菜单中增加一个菜单项，用来快捷自定义各种衣服/帽子/饰品等对应的buff。
[/spoiler]
